title: Copper Tundra: The Cartographer's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the charted evacuation line; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
